name: Proticare Mom 400mg
generic: Whey Protein + Soya Protein + DHA + Vitamins & Minerals Blend
description: Proticare Mom is a wholesome nutritional supplement designed to provide essential nutrients to support healthy growth and overall well-being. It is a sugar-free, gluten-free, and chocolate-flavored powdered drink mix that is easy to prepare and highly nutritious. Suitable for daily consumption as part of a balanced diet, Proticare Mom is not intended for medicinal use or parenteral (I.V.) administration.
indications: Supports healthy growth and development
Provides essential vitamins and minerals for overall wellness
Helps maintain energy and vitality
Gluten-free and sugar-free, suitable for a healthy diet
Delicious chocolate flavor for easy consumption
dosage: Preparation Method: Take a glass of lukewarm milk or water (200ml). Add two scoops of Proticare Mom and stir well until the powder is fully dissolved into a smooth drink.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to folic acid or any excipient. Folic acid should not be used for the treatment of pernicious anaemia or other vitamin B12 deficiency states without concurrent B12 supplementation.
sideEffects: Generally well tolerated. Rarely: mild gastrointestinal disturbances (nausea, flatulence). Hypersensitivity reactions are extremely rare.
interactions: Antiepileptics (phenytoin, carbamazepine) may reduce folic acid levels. Methotrexate antagonises folic acid. Sulphasalazine and trimethoprim reduce absorption.
storage_full: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Protect from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use after the expiry date printed on the packaging.

name: Ova-Wom
description: Ova-Wom is a dietary supplement specifically designed to support women’s reproductive health and overall wellness. Formulated with Myo-Inositol, Folic Acid, Vitamin D3, Melatonin, and Vitamin B12, it helps promote regular menstrual cycles, ovarian function, and hormonal balance. This supplement is ideal for women planning pregnancy or looking to maintain reproductive health while supporting general well-being. Ova-Wom provides essential vitamins and minerals to aid fertility, improve hormonal balance, and support healthy sleep patterns. It is a convenient and reliable option for women seeking targeted nutritional support for reproductive and overall health.
